title: Write the Starter vs Pro pricing section for /solutions/bootcamps, leading with no per-student fees
description: /solutions/bootcamps is the main page for Zedu's primary audience, but it never says 'no per-student pricing', never shows the ₦0 Starter or ₦20K/month Pro price, and never mentions that Starter stops at 3 cohorts. Its only link to /pricing is in the top menu. Deliver in one Markdown file: (1) a pricing section to place before the final CTA: a 2-column Starter vs Pro block using only the wording on zedu.chat/pricing, a 'No per-student fees' line from the home page, and a 'Need more than 3 cohorts?' upgrade prompt; (2) a headline and subhead using 'Run Your Next Cohort Without Limits'; (3) two CTA labels (Start Free and Start Pro Plan) with their target URLs; (4) one line on where Enterprise fits, saying 'Contact Sales' with no price; (5) a source table that ties each line to the live zedu.chat sentence it comes from. Don't quote Enterprise prices, imply per-seat billing, name integrations or use the unproven stats on this page (50% faster, 2x engagement).
rationale: The brief's focus is winning bootcamps and moving Starter users to Pro. The bootcamp page is where that buyer lands, and right now it hides both the flat price and the reason to upgrade.
reviewBlocker: The task has no delivery waiting for review.
